'''Codes''' ---- '''Codes''' are little gifts that the developers sometimes give out that can be redeemed for {{Exp|}}, {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}}, or sometimes towers, skins and emotes. Some codes are given after purchasing a certain item (such as the [[Scout Plush]]), with each one being unique. On rare occasions, towers and emotes may be later moved to the store (like the [[Russian]] emote and [[Militant|John]] tower, now the [[Militant]] tower). You can redeem codes by inputting a code into the code box, which is found on the top right of your screen in the form of an icon with the letter "ABX" whenever you are in the lobby. For skin codes, you need to have the tower in question to redeem the code. If you do not have the tower, you cannot redeem the code. The '''Codes''' page was last updated on the {{LastRevision|long}}. All dates are in the day–month–year (DD/MM/YYYY) format. ---- {{Colour|FFFFFF|Traditional Codes}} These codes are manually created by the developers of the game. Most codes can only be redeemed for a limited time, but some (like the [[Hunter]] tower) are available for extended periods of time. Some codes can also only be used by a set number of people.
